title: Eye-opening unforgettable experience
text: I've done some hikes and would have said I have some awareness and appreciation of what's around me when I'm hiking, but hiking to photograph with Emili opens up new perspectives: I never really noticed much about light and shadows, or the macro world of moss and fungi, or how to tell an impactful story of a waterfall, or view of a mountain, and share it in a way that really captures its beauty and majesty. I can appreciate photography, but I didn't realize I could also tinker with it, with my own mobile phone, when I'm out doing something "ordinary" as a walk in the forest. Highly recommended
author: fatemanuar

title: A day in the Catalan mountains ⛰
text: Had an interesting and enjoyable day with Emili. Highly recommended for anyone who loves nature and wants to learn how to photograph.
author: Travel13891749826

title: Hiking route on the coast near Barcelona with nature, photography, people, yourself
text: An amazing experience witch not only that showed me some beautiful places around Barcelona,  but made me observe every little detail of the route, by taking photos. And more than this, I’ve met other people and shared experiences.
